## About
Mayfair Auto Wreckers started in San Francisco and has been one of the Bay Area's sources for recycled OEM auto parts ever since. We're family owned, and we try to treat everyone who calls or walks in like family.
Our job is simple: affordable, good quality recycled parts that keep your car on the road. If we don't have the part on our lot, we don't stop there. We use part locating technology to help track down what you need.
Neighbors have rated us 4.7 from 61 Google reviews. Whether you search online, call, or stop by, at Mayfair, we care.

## Services
- Recycled OE parts: Used original equipment parts for late model foreign and domestic cars, trucks, SUVs and more.
- Part locating: If the part isn't on our lot, we'll help you find it using part locating technology.
- Sell your vehicle: Have a car you want to sell us? Reach out and tell us whether it starts, whether you have the title and where it's located.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're closed Saturday and Sunday, and open Monday through Friday.

Q: Can I text you instead of calling?
A: Yes. You can text us at 408-638-1319.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We accept all major credit cards, including Visa, MasterCard, Discover and American Express, as well as debit and cash.
